summary: GlitchRadar full-stack test. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases PASS covering list/filter/sort/min_discount, get-by-id (tz fix verified - no 500), 404/400, stats, scans/recent, report-dead, affiliate_url/url presence (known shops like Zalando/Otto/MediaMarkt/IKEA/Amazon/About You/Nike/Lieferando/Rossmann return homepage links, unknown return null), POST /api/scan + concurrent 409 (exactly one pair), and one enrich call returning German instructions/tips/risk_analysis. Frontend: all four tabs (RADAR/SCOUT/STASH/TERMINAL) navigate correctly, 8 seeded glitch cards render with ticker and two chip rows (type + sort), stash button on card uses stopPropagation and does NOT navigate to detail, Stash tab shows share button correctly disabled when empty / enabled after save, claim toggles 'EINGESTRICHEN' amount, remove works, Glitch detail opens with SCHRITTE/RISIKO/DETAILS chips, CTA testID detail-cta-button shows correct text 'CODE KOPIEREN' / 'CODE KOPIEREN & SHOP ÖFFNEN' / 'SHOP ÖFFNEN' / 'ZUM SHOP SUCHEN' per code+link combo, and TOT MELDEN (detail-report-dead) successfully navigates back to the radar list. Terminal shows Auto-Scan switch, 15/30/60 MIN interval chips, min discount chips (ALLE/50/70/80 %+), model stack and 'Stash leeren'. All three previously flagged bugs (tz 500 on detail, nested Pressable bubbling on stash card button, CTA fallback text) are verified fixed. Minor console warning: react-native-web deprecation 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (library-side, not a bug).

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning in console: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Likely coming from a dependency (reanimated / tabs); not blocking. Reference: console warning only.

action_items: No functional issues found. Optional: investigate the pointerEvents deprecation warning source (library upgrade) when convenient.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~680 lines and still manageable, but if more endpoints are added consider splitting LLM scout pipeline, models, and routes into separate modules.
Enrichment endpoint rightfully short-circuits when already enriched (idempotent); scan uses asyncio.Lock to return 409 - both patterns correct.
GlitchDoc.out() correctly injects affiliate link fallbacks for known shops and leaves nulls for unknown ones.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created; relied on existing SEED_GLITCHES inserted on backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://error-scout-20.preview.emergentagent.com (from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_glitchradar_api.py runs in ~16s. The scan test uses a 2s delay to acquire asyncio.Lock before firing concurrent POST and asserts 409. Enrich test picks the first non-enriched glitch. Both LLM-costly tests run exactly once as instructed. Known shop list for affiliate assertions is defined inline in the test file.
rca_of_issue: N/A - all three previously-reported bugs (tz-aware comparison in /glitches/{id}, Pressable event bubbling on stash button, CTA fallback text when no URL) are verified fixed.
